claimed_coverage: Tests that the v component in Ethereum signature JSON is hex-encoded (e.g., "0x1b") rather than a plain integer (e.g., 27), verifying both serialization and roundtrip deserialization for NonEip155 signatures.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix wraps v values in crate::U64::from() for NonEip155 serialization (line 421) and tuple serialization (line 432), and changes deserialization to use crate::U64 instead of u64 (line 560), ensuring hex encoding in JSON output.
issue_context_used: The issue describes that v was emitted as plain integer (27) instead of hex ("0x1b"), breaking compatibility with tools expecting quantity format; the verifier tests this exact behavior.
notes: Hidden integration tests created under /artifacts/evaluation/tests/. The eval.sh script copies tests to the crate's tests/ directory at runtime (required for Rust integration tests) and runs cargo test with the serde feature. Tests verify hex encoding of v field in NonEip155 signatures (v=27 -> "0x1b", v=28 -> "0x1c") and JSON roundtrip preservation.
